dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, I would like something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Well, no. Not really. I actually just wanted to sit and chat with you over a long meal.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I heard that sharing a meal is really important to the people of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's not only about eating, but rather, "sharing an enjoyable time with those that are important to you."

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: When everyone gathers together over a meal, that's called a "get-together," right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's right, especially during the holidays.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Like Lantern Rite? I know that everyone is supposed to release Xiao Lanterns during that holiday... a pity that it's only once a year.

choices.text: There are other holidays, too, you know...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I used to always feel that the holidays had nothing to do with me. But now... there seems to be a longing in my heart for the next holiday to come more quickly.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I would like to use all that I have learned to celebrate together with you.

choices.text: I almost didn't realize it, but...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I've been growing thanks to your constant guidance. Believe me, I won't forget your kindness.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: And my feelings toward you are not only of gratitude...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: But anyway, let's celebrate the next holiday together!

choices.text: For example, the Moonchase Festival. Everyone gathers to enjoy the moonlight together.
